units.official_on_time_percent: percentage rounded as in the published report

all_run_history.method: Deduplicated by world ID with saved final-score evidence; excludes official worlds, demos and incomplete traces. Repeated seeds are correlated; groups are not a time axis.

limitations: Frozen evidence, not a live run count or current leaderboard.
Model stages contain repeated tuning and test configurations; their absolute means are not causal improvements.
The fee and trust effects belong to separate small historical tests and must not be added.
Gamma confirmation is ordinary practice; round 7 is official ranking on different worlds.
Eight fresh practice weeks and one code replay do not guarantee final-clock or restart behavior.
Delta and the unverified token total are outside this published-evidence deck.
